title: Nanoscale dynamics of the cadherin-catenin complex bound to vinculin revealed by neutron spin echo spectroscopy.
authors: Callaway, David J E; Nicholl, Iain D; Shi, Bright; Reyes, Gilbert; Farago, Bela; Bu, Zimei
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该文用中子自旋回波谱研究钙黏蛋白-连环蛋白复合物与纽蛋白结合的纳米级动力学，虽涉及蛋白复合物动态，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且方法为谱学与理论分析，无AI或分子模拟，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: We report a neutron spin echo (NSE) study of the nanoscale dynamics of the cell-cell adhesion cadherin-catenin complex bound to vinculin. Our measurements and theoretical physics analyses of the NSE data reveal that the dynamics of full-length alpha-catenin, beta-catenin, and vinculin residing in the cadherin-catenin-vinculin complex become activated, involving nanoscale motions in this complex. The cadherin-catenin complex is the central component of the cell-cell adherens junction (AJ) and is fundamental to embryogenesis, tissue wound healing, neuronal plasticity, cancer metastasis, and cardiovascular health and disease. A highly dynamic cadherin-catenin-vinculin complex provides the molecular dynamics basis for the flexibility and elasticity that are necessary for the AJs to function as force transducers. Our theoretical physics analysis provides a way to elucidate these driving nanoscale motions within the complex without requiring large-scale numerical simulations, providing insights not accessible by other techniques. We propose a three-way "motorman" entropic spring model for the dynamic cadherin-catenin-vinculin complex, which allows the complex to function as a flexible and elastic force transducer.
abstract_zh: 我们报告了一项中子自旋回波（NSE）研究，探讨了细胞间粘附钙黏蛋白-连环蛋白复合物与纽蛋白结合时的纳米尺度动力学。我们的测量及对NSE数据的理论物理分析揭示，全长α-连环蛋白、β-连环蛋白和纽蛋白在钙黏蛋白-连环蛋白-纽蛋白复合物中的动力学被激活，涉及该复合物内的纳米尺度运动。钙黏蛋白-连环蛋白复合物是细胞间粘附连接（AJ）的核心组成部分，对胚胎发生、组织伤口愈合、神经可塑性、癌症转移以及心血管健康与疾病至关重要。高度动态的钙黏蛋白-连环蛋白-纽蛋白复合物为AJ作为力传导器所需的灵活性和弹性提供了分子动力学基础。我们的理论物理分析提供了一种方法，无需大规模数值模拟即可阐明复合物内这些驱动性的纳米尺度运动，从而提供了其他技术无法获得的见解。我们提出了一个三向“马达”熵弹簧模型来描述动态的钙黏蛋白-连环蛋白-纽蛋白复合物，该模型使复合物能够作为灵活且弹性的力传导器发挥作用。
